bias_targets.methodology: Measuring maximum group-wise smoothed Expected Calibration Error (smECE) and binned ECE across racial and ethnic subpopulations in tabular datasets (ACS Income, HMDA, MEPS) and language datasets (Civil Comments).
Evaluating maximum group-wise calibration error across gender subpopulations in tabular datasets (ACS Income, Credit Default, HMDA), image datasets (CelebA), and language datasets (Civil Comments).

Calculating group-wise calibration errors across distinct age bracket subpopulations in tabular datasets (ACS Income, Bank Marketing, Credit Default, MEPS) and image datasets (CelebA) to evaluate the effectiveness of multicalibration algorithms.

Evaluating differences in calibration error and the impact of multicalibration post-processing across income, poverty, education, and occupational subgroups in tabular datasets like MEPS, Bank Marketing, and Credit Default.
Measuring multicalibration error and predictive confidence disparities for comments mentioning religious identities (e.g., Muslim, Christian) in the Civil Comments dataset.
Assessing group-wise calibration error for toxicity predictions on text comments mentioning LGBTQ identities in the Civil Comments dataset.
